title: Concrete Driveways
shortDescription: Custom-poured concrete driveways built for Ontario winters — reinforced with rebar, properly graded, and finished in natural broom or decorative stamped patterns.
fullDescription: A concrete driveway is the first thing visitors notice and one of the highest-value improvements you can make to your home. We pour every driveway with a compacted granular base, reinforced rebar or wire mesh, air-entrained concrete for freeze-thaw resistance, and engineered control joints that prevent random cracking. Choose from natural broom finish for a classic clean look, or upgrade to coloured and stamped concrete for a high-end decorative surface. Every project includes proper grading for drainage and a written workmanship warranty.
features: Natural broom or stamped finishes available

finishes.name: Natural Broom Finish
finishes.description: The classic choice — textured for grip, clean modern lines, built to outlast Ontario winters. Timeless and low-maintenance.

finishes.name: Coloured Stamped Concrete
finishes.description: Integrally coloured mix stamped with stone, slate, or brick patterns. The look of premium hardscape at a fraction of the cost.

title: Concrete Patios
shortDescription: Custom backyard patios poured to expand your outdoor living space — natural broom finish or coloured stamped concrete with fire pit and seating wall options.
fullDescription: Your patio is the heart of your backyard. We pour custom concrete patios with the same engineered base and reinforced construction as our driveways — designed for your specific layout, slope, and style. Natural broom-finished patios deliver a clean, modern surface that stays cool and slip-resistant. For something more dramatic, our coloured stamped concrete mimics flagstone, slate, or brick with integral colour that won't fade or peel. We can integrate seating walls, steps, and fire pit surrounds during the pour for a cohesive finished outdoor living space.
features: Natural broom or coloured stamped finishes
Optional seating walls, steps, and fire pits
Reinforced for heavy patio furniture and traffic
Properly graded away from the house foundation

finishes.name: Natural Broom Finish
finishes.description: Clean, textured surface perfect for outdoor dining and entertaining. Easy to clean, stays cool, and matches any home style.

finishes.name: Coloured Stamped Concrete
finishes.description: Transform your patio into a showpiece with custom colours and stone patterns. Sealed for UV protection and long-lasting vibrancy.
